cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - Dispenser
cc:Work.dc:description:
Dispenser for stackable (flat) items of same size
Set *bottomheight* to 0 for a wall mounting variant. Please add mounting holes yourself.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes Dispenser --x 80 --y 60 --h 150 --slotheight 6 --viewingwidth 0 --bottomheight 30 --sideedges h --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes Dispenser --x --y --h --slotheight --viewingwidth --bottomheight --sideedges --thickness --reference --labels
